meta.method: synthetic matrix (6000 genes, 6 vs 6 samples), B=200 noise trials; zmap_adj operator = subtract per-sample genome-wide mean; kappa=1 injects the real whole-tissue component means

B3b_signature_coupled_offset.note: the ONLY offset spectrum that reproduces 31.6%/2.04 arithmetically; requires UP/DN genes to be selectively depressed vs 5687 background genes - no technical mechanism targets signature membership, and such a spectrum would itself be the biological signal
